notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Bugs Fixed:
 - If an additional player backed out of the character select screen their build icons would become active and stay on screen and their sprite would stay active and the first players sprite would become inactive
 - Each player besides the first was missing their coin icon
 - Clicking on "Arcade" before it was unlocked will still play the sound effect as if it was unlocked

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
 - Shop wasn't unlocking properly
 - Scores weren't saving
 - Progress was requiring gold medals

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Features:
 - You can now destroy multiple buildings at once. If you hold “Lock” and “Destroy” then the D-Pad in the direction of the building you want to get rid of, every building of that type will get destroyed. This is helpful if you want to earn back some resources before the end of the match

Tweaks:
 - Improved automatic bug reporting

Bug Fixes:
 - “Tutored” achievement wasn’t attainable with the video version of Tutorial Island
 - 40th gallery item wasn’t unlockable
 - You could have a bomb go off infinitely if you removed the building it came from before it blew up
 - Credits didn’t play properly and it wouldn't take you to the “Thanks for Playing” screen
 - Blair couldn’t attack Vilmos in the final level
 - Button prompts weren’t showing up properly

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
 - Players were able to place towers within other towers
 - Minor fixes on the character select screen

Performance:
 - Enemy cache is now cleared at the start and end of levels, speeding the game up when levels are played consecutively, especially with a lot of enemies
 - Some textures were resized

notes.title: Multiplayer Bug Fix
notes.notes: We fixed an issue that prevented local multiplayer, specifically with Playstation 4 controllers.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Tower range indicator now slants properly on mountain levels
 - Weather effects are now disabled in the menus
 - Characters and enemies sped up with other stat tweaks
 - Enemy waypoints fixed in "Big Spiral"
 - Flying enemies paper crumple now comes from the correct spot
 - Notification screen added at start up
 - In-menu shop is now brightened

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed an issue that made it more difficult to beat the final level
